# Battlefield 2: Modern Combat (45410062): one route for every run (the
# campaign is not saved). PLAYED by nav.py on the Thor, 2026-09-27 06:46 PDT
# (lane.titleroutes HELD session bf2mc.first-run-20260927T064649).
#
#   RenderWare and publisher logos (A) -> PRESS START (START) -> PLAY
#   CAMPAIGN (A) -> CREATE CAMPAIGN (A) -> the CAMPAIGN NAME keyboard, cursor
#   on A: A types "A"; START does not submit. The stick does not move this
#   cursor and the hat does: HATX left once reaches BACKSPACE (the row wraps),
#   and HATY down twice reaches ENTER (A) -> "Do you want to save?", cursor on
#   Yes: HATY down to No (A) -> the campaign menu, PLAY FIRST MISSION (A) ->
#   a long load with a tank still, the briefing FMV (A) and the briefing map
#   -> the mission, a Help box: "Press A to continue, Press B to disable
#   help" (B) -> first person in a snowy square at night, "Fight Through To
#   The Rendezvous", mission clock 00:11.
#
# Saying No to the save keeps the disk as it was, so later runs take the
# same path. B turns help off for the mission, so no more help boxes stop
# play during the window.
#
# Player control: LY min walked forward, RX turned, RT fired (ammo 23 -> 15;
# nav frames 019-gameplay -> 020-moved, clock 00:28).
